title: 第1191章 美人下第1190章 美人上
content_zh:
长廊清风徐徐，流云绕栏，两位女子福身行礼，柔婉的贺声落定廊间。
“殿下回归故里，我二人本该早早前来拜见，奈何殿内人多繁杂，不便贸然上前，故而耽搁至今，还望少主勿怪。”
陆长风听出来了，这两女与少主本就相熟，且还有交情。
只听少主道：“二位仙子有心了，快快请起。今日人流繁杂，情理之中。得二位亲自前来道贺，在下受宠若惊……”
啥？在下……
陆长风一度怀疑自己听错了，可继续听下去，少主字正腔圆，说的确是“在下”无疑。这什么情况，他怎么能这样说话？他可是少主啊！这两女到底什么身份？
礼毕起身，青衣女子浅浅一笑，语气带着几分熟稔的嗔怪与感慨，声音更是柔和婉转，入耳熨帖舒心：“殿下这一远赴神界历练，便是数年光阴，竟半点音讯也未曾传回仙界。你倒是自在逍遥，可害得我这妹妹日日惦念，好生牵挂……”
这话一出，身侧的紫衣女子瞬间局促起来。她虽蒙着脸，让人看不清脸上表情，可此刻耳根微微泛红，明显是害羞了。只见她微微轻曳衣袖，细若蚊吟地轻唤一声：“姐姐。”
到这，傻子也能看出端倪了，紫衣女暗恋少主……这没什么稀奇的，就少主这魅力，女的不喜欢他才怪。
少主把这一切看在眼里，连忙拱手致歉，语气越发温和诚恳：“是在下的疏漏，在外数年一直为杂事分神，未曾传信报平安，反倒让二位仙子为在下挂忧，实在抱歉！”
“咯咯，这话倒是说得漂亮，可殿下打算怎么补偿紫萝呢……”青衣女子娇笑不已，抓着少主调侃，让后者连连求饶。
接下来的画面就有意思了，三个俊男美女有说有笑，瞬间成了天宫中最靓丽的风景。
而一旁观望的陆长风，则完完全全成了透明人。紫衣女子自过来后就没看过他一眼，青衣女子也只是冲他微微点头，以示见过，然后就没有然后了。
这就尴尬了，他本来很想跟紫衣女搭上话，可奈何没法介入。话说少主也是，你跟美女聊开心，可也别忘了兄弟啊！多的不用，你好歹介绍下……
可有道是当局者迷，旁观者清。当了背景板的陆长风虽然很失落，却看出了三人之间的微妙。
少主素来待人有礼有度，分寸拿捏得非常好，既保持住身份，又能不给人疏离感。可此刻，他的态度相较平日，明显多了几分热忱与熟稔。尤其是他在说话的时候，目光大半落于青衣女子身上，那眸光温润真挚，却又明显克制，这是陆长风从来没有见过的……
然而面对紫衣女子的时候，少主又礼数周全，分寸得体，言语神态之间终隔着一层疏离的客套，点到即止，从无半分逾矩，就像对其他人一样。
紫衣女子就不用说了，自始至终心神全系在少主身上。她明明羞怯得不敢抬眼直视，却又在少主不注意她的时候悄悄抬瞥，用那温柔炙热的眸光将少主的模样尽数收入眼底。而对于其他的东西或者是连东西都算不上的人，她是一点兴趣也没有，仿佛少主就是她的一切。
这种神态，陆长风很熟，总结一下就是，又菜又爱玩！
到这，陆长风已经看出门道了。紫衣女子暗恋少主，少主却喜欢她姐……好你个帝昊，浓眉大眼的，居然也玩三角恋！

难怪这家伙在凌霄城的时候，对各世家的名媛一点兴趣都没有。陆长风还以为他不近女色，原来是有喜欢的人了……好吧，这不怪他，见过青衣女子这等绝色，再看别的女子，确实都差点意思。
看着他又菜又爱玩的样子，陆长风直想笑，喜欢她你倒是表白啊，你是少主你怕什么？
相对于紫衣女的羞涩和少主的克制，青衣女子的表现就高明多了。她始终笑意盈盈，眉眼温婉，听闻少主致歉也未曾多言宽慰，只是含笑打趣，神态动作大方得体，既保持着恰到好处的亲和，又带着一层淡淡的疏离，姿态端雅，分寸不移，令人全然看不透她的真实心绪……
高手，这是绝对的高手，陆长风隐隐觉得，少主不是她的对手！
问候叙旧过后，二女并无久留之意。青衣女子再度福身，从容开口道：“殿内宴席未歇，我二人不便久离，便不叨扰殿下清静，先行告退。”
说罢，她拉着紫衣女子并肩转身，便要缓步离去。
“……”
少主下意识抬手欲唤住二人，可话到嘴边又骤然顿住，是碍于身份分寸，又或是一时不知如何开口。几番微动，他最终还是将挽留的话语默默咽了回去，眼底掠过一丝淡淡的怅然。
陆畜何等反应，心念一转，当即顺势上前半步，高声开口拦住二人：“两位仙子姐姐，请留步！”
前方即将离去的两道身影骤然驻足。
紫衣女子身躯极轻一颤，原本低垂的眼眸骤然亮起，细碎的光亮藏在眼底。她依旧克制着外露的笑意，不敢太过张扬，眉眼间却翻涌着藏不住的欣喜，眸光灼灼望向少主的方向，眷恋又雀跃。
青衣女子也顺势转过身来，依旧眉眼带笑，向陆长风温声问道：“这位朋友，可是有何指教？”
“指教不敢当，只是我……在下初见两位姐姐，简直跟惊为天人，跟画里走出来的一样，还未请教两位芳……芳名！”
这……
说实话，以陆畜现在的蠢愣人设，说出这种话已经很不容易了，可还是有些冒犯。毕竟他一个神界来的糙汉，天生就低人一等，而人家是什么，连少主都要自称在下的存在。他这般发言，听起来很像是见色起意，完全是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，人家都没拿正眼看过他好吗？
果然，紫衣女子立时嗔怒，虽然蒙着脸看不清表情，可那眼神中明显透着不善。倒是青衣女子处变不惊，停下脚步看着陆长风。
少主面上也有些不快，可他见陆长风一个劲给他使眼色，马上懂了。
content_en:
There was a gentle breeze blowing in the corridor, and flowing clouds circled the railings. The two women saluted, and their soft congratulations settled in the corridor.
"His Royal Highness has returned to his hometown. I and I should have come to see him early. However, there are many people in the palace and it is inconvenient to rush forward. Therefore, we have been delayed so far. I hope you don't blame me, young master."
Lu Changfeng heard that the two women were familiar with the young master and had friendship.
I only heard the young master say: "The two fairies are interested, please get up quickly. There are many people today, which is reasonable. I am flattered that you two come to congratulate me in person..."
What? Next...
Lu Changfeng once suspected that he had heard wrongly, but as he continued to listen, the young master's words were correct and there was no doubt that he meant "I'm here". What's going on, how can he talk like this? He is the young master! What are the identities of these two women?
After standing up, the woman in green smiled lightly, with a familiar tone of anger and emotion. Her voice was soft and gentle, and it was soothing to the ears: "His Highness has gone to the God Realm for several years to experience, but no news has been sent back to the Immortal Realm. You are free and easy, but you make my sister miss you every day and worry about you..."
As soon as these words came out, the woman in purple beside him instantly became embarrassed. Although her face was covered so that no one could see the expression on her face, her ears were slightly red at the moment, obviously she was shy. I saw her tugging at her sleeves slightly and calling as softly as a mosquito: "Sister."
At this point, even a fool can see the clues. The girl in purple has a secret crush on the young master... This is nothing strange. With the young master's charm, it is strange that the woman doesn't like him.
The young master saw all this and quickly apologized, his tone becoming gentler and more sincere: "It was my oversight. I have been distracted by chores for several years abroad and did not send a message to report that I was safe. Instead, I made the two fairies worry about me. I am really sorry!"
"Giggle, that's a beautiful thing to say, but how is His Highness going to compensate Zi Luo..." The woman in green smiled sweetly, grabbing the young master and teasing her, making the latter beg for mercy again and again.
The next scene is interesting. Three handsome men and beauties are talking and laughing, instantly becoming the most beautiful scenery in the palace.
Lu Changfeng, who was watching from the sidelines, became completely transparent. The woman in purple clothes had not glanced at him since she came here, and the woman in green clothes just nodded slightly at him to show that she had seen him, and then nothing happened.
This was embarrassing. He originally wanted to strike up a conversation with the girl in purple, but he couldn't intervene. By the way, young master, you have fun chatting with the beauty, but don’t forget your brother! There’s no need for more, you can at least introduce it...
But the authorities are confused by the truth, but bystanders know it clearly. Although Lu Changfeng was disappointed when he became the backdrop, he saw the subtlety between the three of them.
The young master has always been polite and courteous to others, and has a very good sense of proportion. He can maintain his identity without giving people a sense of alienation. But at this moment, his attitude was obviously more enthusiastic and familiar than usual. Especially when he was talking, most of his eyes fell on the woman in green. Her eyes were warm and sincere, but obviously restrained. This was something Lu Changfeng had never seen before...
However, when facing the woman in purple, the young master was polite and well-proportioned. There was always a layer of distant politeness between his words and demeanor, and he never went beyond the rules, just like he did with other people.
Needless to say, the woman in purple clothes was always focused on the young master. She was obviously too shy to raise her eyes to look directly at him, but she quietly glanced up when the young master wasn't paying attention to her, taking in all the young master's appearance with her gentle and hot eyes. As for other things or people who are not even things, she has no interest at all, as if the young master is everything to her.
Lu Changfeng is very familiar with this attitude. To sum it up, he is both good and fun-loving!
By this point, Lu Changfeng had already figured out the clue. The woman in purple clothes has a secret crush on the young master, but the young master likes her sister... How dare you, Di Hao, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, you actually play a love triangle!
No wonder this guy treated everyone when he was in Lingxiao CityThe ladies of the aristocratic family were not interested at all. Lu Changfeng thought that he was not a womanizer, and it turned out that he had someone he liked... Well, it's not his fault. After seeing such a stunning woman in Tsing Yi, looking at other women, it was indeed almost boring.
Seeing his naughty and fun-loving look, Lu Changfeng wanted to laugh. You should confess that you like her. You are the young master, what are you afraid of?
Compared to the shyness of the purple-clothed woman and the restraint of the young master, the green-clothed woman's performance was much better. She always had a smile on her face, and her eyes were gentle. When she heard the young master apologized, she didn't say much to comfort her. She just smiled and joked, and her movements were generous and appropriate. She maintained just the right amount of intimacy, but also had a faint layer of alienation. Her posture was elegant and measured, making it impossible to see through her true mood...
Master, this is an absolute master. Lu Changfeng vaguely felt that the young master was no match for her!
After greeting each other and reminiscing about old times, the two girls had no intention of staying for a long time. The woman in green clothes was blessed again and said calmly: "The banquet in the palace has not stopped yet. It is inconvenient for the two of us to be away for a long time, so I will not disturb your highness's peace and leave first."
After saying that, she pulled the purple-clothed woman side by side, turned around, and left slowly.
"..."
The young master subconsciously raised his hand to call the two of them, but when the words reached his mouth, he suddenly stopped. This was due to his sense of status or because he didn't know how to speak. After a few slight movements, he finally swallowed back the words of restraint silently, with a hint of sadness in his eyes.
What was Lu Zhu's reaction? He changed his mind and immediately took advantage of the situation and took half a step forward. He shouted loudly to stop the two of them: "Two fairy sisters, please stay!"
The two figures who were about to leave in front suddenly stopped.
The purple-clothed woman's body trembled slightly, and her originally downcast eyes suddenly lit up, with tiny gleams of light hidden in her eyes. She still restrained her outward smile and did not dare to be too showy, but there was unconcealable joy in her eyebrows. She looked towards the direction of the young master with burning eyes, nostalgic and excited.
The woman in green clothes also turned around, still smiling, and asked Lu Changfeng warmly: "This friend, do you have any advice?"
"I don't take advice seriously, it's just that I... I was astonished when I first met my two sisters, just like they walked out of a painting. I haven't even asked them their names... yet!"
This...
To be honest, with Lu Zhu's current stupid character, it is not easy to say such things, but it is still a bit offensive. After all, he is a rough guy from the God Realm, and he is inherently inferior to others. And what is he, even the young master has to call himself an inferior being. When he spoke like this, it sounded like he was motivated by sexual desire. He was just trying to eat the swan's flesh. No one looked at him seriously, okay?
Sure enough, the woman in purple clothes immediately became angry. Although her face was covered and her expression could not be seen clearly, there was clearly evil in her eyes. On the other hand, the woman in Tsing Yi remained calm and stopped to look at Lu Changfeng.
The young master was also a little unhappy on his face, but when he saw Lu Changfeng winking at him, he understood immediately.
